title: Do We Really Have Souls? The Truth Behind Karma & Afterlife
description:
Imagine checking into a luxury hotel where everything is free — until you’re told the bill will be collected from your children. Sounds absurd, right? Yet this is exactly what religions promise through the theory of karma and the soul.

In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts unpacks the Hotel Karma Inn story as a metaphor for how religions sell the concept of Atma (soul) and reincarnation. From Hinduism’s eternal Atman, Christianity’s ensoulment, Islam’s 120-day “rooh infusion,” to Greek philosophers like Pythagoras and Plato imagining the transmigration of souls — the idea has no scientific evidence .

We also revisit the infamous 21 grams experiment of Dr. Duncan MacDougall, who tried to weigh the soul. His flawed study on six patients (and poisoned dogs!) claimed that the soul had physical weight. The scientific community debunked this quickly, showing natural processes like sweat, air loss, or urination explain weight changes — not the soul.

Religions teach that karma passes bills from one life to the next. Krishna in the Bhagavad Gita even told Arjuna that killing wasn’t real since souls never die. But if souls just “move on,” why grieve for loved ones? As Ambedkar said, Krishna would make a bad lawyer if that was his defense.

Today, “soul” has been rebranded as consciousness by gurus like Sadhguru and Deepak Chopra. But science shows that consciousness is an emergent property of the brain, not a mystical USB stick that plugs in. Just like wetness emerges from H₂O molecules, consciousness emerges from neural networks.

If you’ve searched for karma theory debunked, soul exposed, reincarnation myth, 21 grams hoax, Krishna Gita soul explained, or consciousness vs soul, this video uncovers the truth.

#KarmaDebunked #SoulMyth #21GramsHoax #CriticalThinking #ScienceOverSuperstition
